newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-PAKISTAN RECALL MUJTABA, ELAHI FOR LANKA TOUR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN RECALL MUJTABA, ELAHI FOR LANKA TOUR.

text.p: Middle-order batsman Asif Mujtaba and opener Salim Elahi were recalled by Pakistan on Saturday for their forthcoming short tour of Sri Lanka.

Left-hander and left-arm spinner Mujtaba, and Elahi, have replaced Sajid Ali and Shahid Afridi respectively from the squad on duty for the three-nation Sharjah Cup that ended in the United Arab Emirates on Friday.

Mujtaba toured England last year and gave a good account of himself but was not considered for the subsequent home series against Zimbabwe and New Zealand, nor for the tour of Australia that followed.
Elahi was in the party who went to Australia essentially for the triangular World Series Cup.
Wasim Akram captains the squad of 14 who leave for Colombo on Monday for a three-match itinerary.
The tour opens on Tuesday with a two-day game against a Sri Lanka Board President's XI followed by two tests, on April 19-23 and April 26-30.

Pakistan squad: Wasim Akram (captain), Ramiz Raja (vice-captain), Salim Elahi, Asif Mujtaba, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Ijaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Mohammad Wasim, Moin Khan, Waqar Younis, Mohammad Zahid, Shahid Nazir, Mushtaq Ahmed, Saqlain Mushtaq.
